about: lib/scrub.ts: scrub.sim.cjs's checks by name (fn, args, result - a drag as {pointer, track, time}, a pending seek as {target, since}); the readout's runs (every reading and describeSeek after each event); seeded drags (each step's op, the drag after it, and what end seeks or shown shows); sweeps of timeAt [x, left, width, length, time], keyTarget [key, from, length, target] and reportedPosition [pending, position, now, reported].
made_by: ios/scripts/export-screen-vectors.cjs - never edit by hand: change the TypeScript and run it again

sim.name: the left end is the start
the right end is the end
the middle is half way
60% across
a finger past the left end is at the start
a finger past the right end is at the end
no length yet: nothing to seek to
a bar with no width (not laid out): 0, not NaN
right arrow: forward a step
up arrow (VoiceOver swipe up): forward a step
left arrow: back a step
down arrow: back a step
page up: forward a page
page down: back a page
home: the start
end: the end
back from 2 s stops at the start
forward from 298 s stops at the end
a key that is not the bar's: null, so the page keeps it
space is not a seek
no length yet: no key seeks
three quick presses step from each other's targets
three quick presses step from each other's targets
three quick presses step from each other's targets

put down: it is where the finger is
the bar shows the finger, not the song
moved: it follows
a second finger moving changes nothing
a move to where it already is is the same drag (no render)
no drag: a move is nothing
a second finger lifted changes nothing
let go: seeks to where the LAST move put it
cancelled (the system took the touch): seeks nowhere, and lets go
after it is gone, the lost capture that follows an up does nothing
a tap is a drag that never moved: seeks where it landed
the song changed under the finger: the drag is let go of
same song: the drag stays
let go, the bar shows the song's position again
the bar never shows past the end
nor before the start
with no length yet, the position as it is
the target, not where the song was
an update from before the seek lands can't move it
no seek on its way: the song's position
one that never landed lets go after a while
...and not before
nothing is 0:00
never negative
